top: Posts on a world map that spread as people engage. Free on iPhone and Android · Toronto beta. Share locally. Let your posts travel.
beta: Join the beta. iPhone and Android. Enter your email and we will send you the tester agreement; sign it with your name and your links unlock — TestFlight for iOS, Google Play for Android.
live: The numbers, as they happen. Follow the Toronto beta as people join, share and discover what is happening nearby. This scorecard reports participation and activity during the beta. The beta scorecard. People only. Poplur runs a labelled synthetic cohort as a pre-launch harness; it is counted apart and never appears here. Counts are shown with their denominators — a pending read means the day it measures has not passed yet. Pops on the map right now.
features: Reach, without followers. A new way to share and discover.
map: See what is popping around you. Explore a clay world with live weather and time of day. Discover nearby moments and watch posts travel beyond their neighbourhood.
radius: Reach is earned per post, not per account. Your post starts nearby. As people engage, it reaches more people—giving every post a chance to travel, even without a following.
feed: Discover posts reaching your area. Find interesting posts from people and places around you—even if you do not follow the creator.
place: Share what is happening where you are. Put a moment, a discovery or an idea on the map and connect with people nearby.
ai: Post where it will travel. AI helps you find places where your next post could connect with people. Get suggestions and creative tools to help bring your ideas to life.
types: Photos, carousels, video, music, podcasts. Games and apps are designed into the same post pipeline, and AI tools help people make the post itself.
business: Reach the people who can walk in. Help nearby customers discover your business. Promote a post to reach more people in places that matter to you.
